So this was our big adventure yesterday! We went to @coyotepointmarina and got to look at all the cool birds and boats and met a lot of really nice people who said they loved meeting me (I mean...of course...). And then we went to the new @meta complex that was built for something called "Oculus" (I can't even imagine what that could be!). The buildings were a bit stark for my taste, but the landscaping is quite beautiful! Oh and we also invited our friend Rhubarb to come along. She is a domestic Ringneck dove who my Aunt Kyla adopted from @pigeondiplomacy - I think she enjoyed seeing the pipers the most because they are similar to her in size. For me, the coolest thing of the day was those pipers flying in these amazing formations where they would be a giant shimmering swooping shape and then boom--they change formation and you can't even see them anymore! I will ask my mom to post a video of it later. We were all pretty tired afterwards so it was dinner, a quick scritch, and then bedtime...time to dream of egrets and pipers and the sound of water rolling up and washing over the rocks. It was a perfect day.

With close to 250 puppies at Palm Valley Animal Society we’re in need of fosters and foster supplies. Providing fosters with the tools they need to care for animals helps more people foster, which helps more animals - it will help us save more lives.

♥️ZUHAUSE GESUCHT♥️

Unsere niedliche Labbi-Maus Sancha lebte gemeinsam mit ihrem Sohn mindestens 4 Jahre lang im staatlichen Tierheim. Dort leben die Hunde in kleinen Zwingern ohne jemals nach draußen zu kommen, Menschenkontakt und Umweltreize gibt es in der Regel sehr wenig. Für die Hunde ist das Leben dort schrecklich.

Name: Sancha (weiblich)

Geschätztes Geburtsdatum: Januar 2016 
Größe (ca.): 48cm

Aufenthaltsort: Pfötchenfarm, Portugal 
Im Tierheim seit: August 2023

Trotz der schlimmen letzten Jahre ist Sancha einfach nur lieb, aufgeschlossen und verschmust. Sancha liebt die Menschen und sucht stets Kontakt und Nähe. Auch mit den anderen Hunden kommt sie super aus und wird auch von allen akzeptiert. Sie und ihr Sohn Sancho sind ein super Team, müssen aber nicht zusammen adoptiert werden. Wir denken aufgrund ihrer menschenbezogenen Art, dass Sancha wahrscheinlich mal eine Familie hatte und den Kontakt gewöhnt ist. Da der Labrador ja eine sehr beliebte Rasse ist, können wir uns gut vorstellen, dass sie und ihr Welpe von verantwortungslosen Menschen angeschafft und dann im Tierheim abgegeben wurde, als bemerkt wurde, dass so ein Hund ja auch Arbeit bedeutet.

Sancha sucht nun nach der Chance, die er schon vor einigen Jahren hätte bekommen sollen. Die schokobraune Maus soll endlich ankommen dürfen in einer eigenen Familie, geliebt und umsorgt werden und ein tolles Hundeleben führen dürfen. Wer möchte Sanchas Traum wahr werden lassen?

There is a time for teaching. There is a time for learning and very important… there is a time for healing.  Not heeling… healing. 

If a dog is unable to take the world in without fear, panic or rage at home, how the hell are you going to capture good choices in the world beyond your front door?

My program teaches you to guide your dog through very focused and clear steps towards being more able, more willing, more trusting in you as the person who has everything under control. If you want your dog to stop lashing out or reacting, you have to know the pieces to teach them how not to experience life with concern. 

Virtual lessons worldwide have enabled pet parents far and wide to build this house of goodness and it is absolutely gorgeous to watch. I am forever grateful to be a part of so many successful journeys 🌟

Oreo needs an adult only household with no other pets and someone that will give her the time she needs to realize that she is safe, loved, and will never be abandoned again.

One of our employees shared a moving story about how one shelter pup saved her and countless other shelter pets since then.❤️ 

She met Georgie when he was teetering on the brink of life and death. He arrived at the shelter in a cardboard box with a note stating his owners had done everything to help him, but it wasn't enough. Georgie was brought into the euthanasia room where she was working as the euthanasia technician that night. All shelter staff had already left except a handful of veterinary assistants, meaning there was no opportunity for rescue or foster placement for this fading puppy. She could see the life in his eyes when he was placed on the table. Instead of euthanizing him, she took him home as her first foster puppy and vowed to do everything she could to keep him alive.

You see, Georgie had come into her life during a dark time. She had been struggling with her mental health and felt as if she had nothing to live for. That was until she met Georgie. Not only did she find purpose in caring for him but a calling for animal welfare. Seeing Georgie's transformation encouraged her to fight for all animals. She knew every animal saved would save another person. Soon she transferred within the shelter to become our foster program manager and now works for our development team raising funds to support our lifesaving programs. Since Georgie, she has fostered over 90 pets.

She gave Georgie a second chance at life, but he gave her and all the animals she's saved a second chance at theirs. 

This Giving Tuesday, we'd like to invite you to donate on behalf of the pet that saved you. None of our lifesaving work would be possible without your support. Text PVASTuesday to 76278 to donate or share your story.

Since kittens already have weak immune systems, it looks a lot like when a human gets a bad cold: stuffy nose, sore through, watery eyes, and sneezing. Meine aktuelle Meldeadresse ist der  Shelter nahe Bukarest☺️. 
Hier ist ganz schön was los kann ich euch sagen😅...ich tummel mich mit ganz vielen anderen frechen Zwergen im Welpenkennel.
Von hier aus, darf ich nun meine Familie suchen😍🙌🏽. Was "Familie" bedeutet weiß ich nicht wirklich😔. Es bereitet mir dennoch ein warmes Gefühl um mein kleines Herzchen, denn es  fühlt sich nach Sicherheit und Geborgenheit an🥰.
Ich habe noch nichts von der Welt gesehen und weiß auch noch nicht so recht wie das mit den Menschen eigentlich so läuft😅. Aber ich weiß dass ich sie mag und zeige mich offen und welpentypisch verspielt im Kontakt 🤭...und meine Artgenossen mag ich sowieo😅.
Ich wünsche mir eine Familie, die mit mir die Welt erobert und mich auf dem Weg zu einer sozialen, aufgeschlossen und treuen Gefährtin begleitet☺️.
Dass mit dem Welpen 1x1 bekomme ich auch hin, bin schließlich ein smarter Bub🤭 🥰🙏🏽‼️
